tasks.subject: Task 6: Declination revision + similarity fit
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure revision math: per-trip declination rotation + numeric rigid-change detector.

**Files:**
- Modify: scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsRevise.js
- Test: tests/js_unit.js (node-safe)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- reviseDeclination rotates azimuth+backAzimuth of the trip's shots (incl. splays/flagged), normalizes, updates trip record, returns {delta}
- similarityFit closed-form Procrustes (theta, scale, tx, ty, maxResidual), no reflection
- classifyChange: rigid iff maxResidual < 1e-6*extent and uniform z; moved list sorted desc
- tests: single-trip change rigid with numerically-asserted theta sign; one-trip-of-two non-rigid; edited shot non-rigid with correct top mover; wraparound

**Verify:** node tests/js_unit.js -> ### UNIT OK

**Steps:** plan Task 6; TDD.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsRevise.js", "tests/js_unit.js"], "verifyCommand": "node tests/js_unit.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["revision math", "rigid detector"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
